title: Why Are Art Schools Closing?
content: American Academy of Art Collegein Chicago has announced that it will close its doors permanently.It was founded in 1923 with a curriculum that emphasized painting and drawing and painting from live models.Graduates include some legendary illustrators and easel painters: Thomas Blackshear, Alex Ross, Richard Schmid, Howard Terpning, Gil Elvgren, and Haddon Sundblom.The closure of American Academy in Chicago follows the closing of UArts in Philadelphia and the Art Institutes all across the country.
